## Proposal and provenance

Stable algorithm slug: `redundancy-discounted-structural-weight`. Source: pm-4k6b note recorded 2026-08-10T21:02:34.076Z.

Signal candidate (39) — redundancy-discounted structural weight. Every graph-derived relevance signal currently treats an item's edges as equally informative, but pm graph redundancy witnesses 73 of the ordering edges as transitively implied and returns the witness path for each. An item whose degree is inflated by implied edges therefore out-ranks an item of equal real connectivity, and centrality makes this worse because its edge basis is simple_undirected: it collapses direction AND kind before it runs, so a blocks row and a related row weigh the same. The candidate signal discounts an item's structural score by the fraction of its incident edges the redundancy analytic witnesses as implied. Discount-only, never raises a score. Degeneracy is total and cheap to check: when redundant_count is 0 — every fresh workspace, every small project — the discount is identically 1 and the ranking is unchanged, so this can never be the reason a small corpus ranks badly. Route through pm-g8t7b9 with the other candidates; do NOT weight it on the single incident that surfaced it. Distinct from (37) (the object moves) and (38) (the instrument is unverified): here the object and instrument are both fine and the UNIT is wrong — the same defect class as pm-9gzr4r one layer up, where a bound denominated in total edges could not tell a repair from a regression. Depends on the derived-measurement primitive (pm-2lex4r) landing, because the discount is exactly a derived measurement over two existing analytics.

Scope clarification from individual-ownership review: pm-2lex4r owns a related measurement, read primitive or defect fix. It does not independently deliver this proposed ranking behavior. Reuse its evidence and public API; evaluate the additional behavior in this experiment.

## Delivery boundary

Evaluate this mechanism as a bounded public-SDK experiment before any production adoption. Use the existing scorer and packer contracts; no CLI-only behavior or new command noun. The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented.

## Experiment protocol

Freeze a workspace/history revision and parameter manifest. Compare against the current deterministic SDK baseline using held-out judgments and negative controls. Report nDCG/action success, critical-evidence omission, latency p50/p95, peak memory, tokens per completed task, and rebuild cost separately. Include 3-item/minutes, real-shaped, 100k/1M-item, decades-long, and sparse/dense/imbalanced graph scenarios; smoke subsets may not claim scale acceptance. Bound candidate counts, graph expansions, elapsed time, and output size, with cancellation and completeness receipts. Record exact versus approximate behavior and approximation error; theoretical guarantees require their stated assumptions. Missing or untrusted evidence remains unknown, never inferred proof.

Promotion requires a reproducible quality improvement on the held-out target population, no regression of existing exact invariants or mandatory gates, and a declared compute/token cost justified by that improvement. Reject or defer with the same immutable evidence if those conditions fail. No production default, adaptive learning, or data export is authorized by this planning item.
